title: The online monotone array completion problem
summary: Consider the following online filling game. An array of length $n$ is initially empty. At each time step one observes an independent sample from $\mathrm{Unif}[0,1]$ and must either discard it or place it irrevocably into an empty position of the array, while preserving the constraint that the occupied entries are non-decreasing from left to right. Among all possible strategies, what is the optimal expected time required to fill the array? Let $v_n$ denote this optimal expected completion time. Our main result determines $v_n$ up to lower-order terms: \[ v_n=\left(\frac12+o(1)\right)n\log n.…
